text.description_html:
MNG 18426, Square Bling Cabinet Knob in Polished Chrome

The Bellagio Square Knob in Polished Chrome is a modern way to add a little bling to your life. We've seen these stunning Crystal Bellagio Square Cabinet Knob in Polished Chrome shine in contemporary kitchens as a way for designer's to add a beautiful point of interest to sleek upper cabinets. But the Square Bling Cabinet Knob in Polished Chrome aren't just for your kitchen remodel. This jeweled cabinet hardware can be used anywhere a small knob is desired such as on dressers or end tables. Make your home TikTok worthy with these designer cabinet knobs.

This cabinet knob is part of the MNG Bellagio Collection.

Specifications and Features of the MNG 18426 Crystal Bellagio Square Knob in Polished Chrome:

  • Base Material: Zinc / Crystal
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length: 1" square
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
